title.narrative: Rural Women Peace Link - Wezesha Amani Mashinani na Wamama (Grassroot Women enabling peace)
Rural Women Peace Link - Wezesha Amani Mashinani na Wamama (Grassroot Women enabling peace)

description.narrative:
Current data, both nationally and at the county, on women?s inclusion in conflict resolution, peacekeeping and peace building process is still at an all-time low, yet the County government and its departments as duty bearers need to deliver on bills, budgeting and financing of recommendations from KNAP 1. Gaps found out that many important actors are unaware of KNAP UNSCR1325 and its detailed Pillars and expectations of them, nor their roles in reversing the situation .It is not clear to government organs, like chiefs. Community policing committees, Nyumba kumi initiative, and village Elders. They are not sufficiently empowered to make interventions for lack of knowledge and laws on SGBV and sexual offense laws or clinking the laws to 1325. Educating them on this will be paramount to better equip them with knowledge that will help reduce cases and respond rightly.
The project will focus on all the 4 Pillars, including relief and recovery, due to the situation brought about by COVID-19. The Project will be carried out in Four counties in Kenya, where RWPL has a long-standing experience working with the grassroots communities and organisation
Project Objectives:
1. To enhance capacities, partnership and coordination among stakeholders and institutions to promote effective service delivery for SGBV Survivors by 2022.
2. To increase representation of women in decision making, leadership and participation in conflict prevention and resolution by 2022.
3. To Enhance accountability for inclusive and responsive governance and planning by 2022
Project Goal: To support County Integration of KNAP /UNSCR1325 through enhanced collaboration and partnerships between service providers and the community structures in Bungoma, West Pokot, Nandi and Uasin Gishu Counties by 2022.
